commentary: Verified the two walks this same session wrote, so the reacting class grades its own repairs; the residual check (diff from 72898989, the commit that added the external return, plus untracked files) listed ten files, every one inside an entry's edit record. The all_done clause and the mixed-walk rule landed at every site they claim, including D-ca-4's supersession, whose rules probe parsed two live rules with no defects, and the delta's row, proposal, design, tasks and test; the converged external warning's stale call is right, and its context point rides the fresh half's repair. The glossary repair is present and true, but extends a Carried by line that never named the owner of the trail's decisions/ folder. docs/cli.md's one-line summary of when a walk replaces the account was read and left alone, a user-level simplification. The reading step: a first reader was dispatched pointing at a file instead of with the brief verbatim, and was stopped before it reported; the second received the brief verbatim. Its pattern: the account's fields are restated in three records more narrowly than D-ca-1 states them ('plan' for the stage's charter, the setting half dropped), the narrowing the account step's own one-line summary carries; and two records rest on D-ca-1 alone, now two supersessions back, which the reader flagged outside its four rows.
